_about: Prompts for the ohm cover images (DESIGN.md, 'Light'). The image carries no text: type is laid over it by Cover. `style` is appended to every prompt. Run: npm run covers -- <id> [<id>…] (needs OPENAI_API_KEY in .env.local). `style` is the current look (in between: present but soft); `style_rich` (fuller) and `style_minimal` (almost blank) are earlier looks, kept for reference.
style: Fine-art architectural photograph through frosted glass, liminal and quiet, between architecture, technology and the human body. Soft and luminous rather than blank: the architecture is clearly there (glass walls, a corridor, a lit volume, racks of light) but softened by diffusion, about a third of the frame holding form and the rest open light. Near-white (#f5f7f4) and pale celadon mist (#dbe5de), mid-tones in muted sage (#5f8a6c), a few small accents of deep forest green (#013220), never hard black. The light shimmers: gentle halation, faint iridescent fringes, a few vertical streaks of light, fine analog grain. A person, when present, reads clearly as a person but blurred and partly dissolved, never sharp. The lower-left third stays calm and pale for type. No plants, nature, water or landscapes. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, signage, logos, watermarks or frames.

prompts.prompt: A long, empty corridor lined with backlit frosted glass walls glowing from within, the vanishing point slightly right of centre. Far down the corridor a single person stands, only a soft blurred silhouette dissolving into the light. Low carpet, pale ceiling, the walls' light bleeding into the air.

A tall atrium enclosed by a curving wall of translucent milky glass panels lit from behind, the wall undulating like a wave under a smooth pale ceiling. The glass is so bright it almost burns out. A low dark planter edge at the very bottom, the floor fading into mist. Seen slightly from below, monumental and silent.

A person standing directly behind a sheet of frosted acrylic, pressed close enough that their head and shoulders appear as a soft green-grey shadow, the rest dissolving into overexposed white. One hand faintly touches the glass. Intimate, ghostly, still.

An overexposed, bleached close-up portrait fragment: only a closed eye and the curve of lips emerge from a field of white, tinted pale green like a faded inverted film negative, the rest of the face lost to light. Placed toward the right half of the frame.
A doorway in a wall of glowing frosted glass, the door slightly open onto pure white light. Long soft reflections on a polished pale floor. A threshold between rooms, nobody there.

Abstract long-exposure photograph of light moving behind ribbed frosted glass: soft vertical pillars and liquid blooms of white light separated by sage-green shadow, like light seen through a shower screen. Experimental, painterly, no recognisable objects.
A narrow stair rising into a void of white light between two walls of backlit frosted glass. A blurred figure halfway up, turned away, almost transparent. Vertical, quiet, architectural.

A tall window of frosted glass in a dim pale room, the light behind it so strong the frame softens away; the silhouette of a person outside the glass is a faint green shadow in the upper half. Vertical composition.

A large frosted glass cube standing in an empty white room, glowing evenly from within like a lightbox, its light shimmering across the polished pale floor. A dark doorway at the far right edge. Silent, monumental, a sculpture of light.

The motion trace of a single dark green dot moving across pale paper-white space: a sequence of soft out-of-focus round dots arcing upward from lower left to upper right, growing smaller and fainter, photographed in a long exposure through frosted glass. One faint thin curve of pale light crossing behind them.

Rows of server racks seen through a wall of frosted glass: their tiny lights smear into tall shimmering vertical streaks of pale green-white light. A person walks past between the rows, only a translucent ghost in long exposure.

Abstract: a few thin vertical lines of dark light, each with a soft starburst where it crosses one faint horizontal band, like a spectrograph or interference pattern photographed through frosted glass, on a vast pale shimmering field.

Behind frosted glass, the profile of a person's face lit only by the cool glow of a screen they are looking at; the face is a soft green-grey shadow, the glow blooms and shimmers across the glass. Right half of the frame.

A long frosted glass wall in an empty building with a bright band of light sweeping along it like a scanner, leaving shimmering horizontal afterimages. A single hand pressed flat against the glass, blurred.
A tall narrow frosted glass column glowing from within in an empty pale gallery, a person standing beside it reduced to a translucent silhouette by long exposure. Vertical, quiet.

A narrow passage between two walls of backlit frosted glass with thin vertical lines of brighter light inside the glass like fibre optics; far away, a person walks toward the light. Vertical composition.

An almost empty wall of frosted glass lit evenly from behind. Toward the right, one thin vertical seam where the light is a little brighter, and beside it the faintest shadow of a person standing on the other side, barely distinguishable from the glass.
A vast pale wall with a single thin vertical line of shimmering light running floor to ceiling, slightly right of centre. Far away at its foot, a very small figure, almost dissolved.
Behind a sheet of frosted glass, the faintest trace of a person: only the soft line of a head and one shoulder in very pale sage, the rest of the body lost to white. Right third of the frame.
A soft horizontal band of brighter light crossing an empty white room at eye level, shimmering slightly at its edges. A single silhouette crosses the band far away, so faint it might be a reflection.
A single small soft dot of pale green light behind frosted glass, far out of focus, upper right, trailing the faintest smear of light toward the left. Everything else is white.
The corner of an empty white room where two walls of backlit frosted glass meet; the corner line almost disappears in the glow. A doorway in deep pale shadow at the far right.
A tall field of frosted glass lit from behind with two faint vertical seams of brighter light; near the bottom of one seam, the barest silhouette of a person.

A long hall lined on the right with walls of backlit frosted glass, their light falling across a pale floor. Midway down, a person walks away, blurred by long exposure but clearly a figure. The left side is open soft light.

Behind a wall of frosted glass, rows of server racks on the right half, their small lights softened into gentle vertical streaks of pale green-white. A person stands between the rows, blurred, looking at them.

A frosted glass cube lit from within stands right of centre in an empty white room, its edges soft, its light shimmering on the floor. A person stands near it, a soft silhouette at the edge of its glow.

Behind frosted glass on the right, the soft profile of a person lit by the cool light of a screen in front of them; the face and shoulder read clearly but blurred, the glow shimmering across the glass.

A tall wall of frosted glass panels lit from behind, their seams faint. On the other side, right of centre, a person stands with one hand resting on the glass; the hand is a little sharper, the body dissolves upward into light.
An empty pale gallery with two glowing frosted glass columns on the right, light pooling on the polished floor. A blurred person passes between them.
A narrow aisle between two walls of backlit frosted glass with faint vertical lines of light inside; halfway down, a blurred person walks toward the light. Vertical composition.

style_rich: Fine-art architectural photograph, liminal and quiet, between architecture, technology and the human body, as if shot on medium-format film through frosted glass. Overexposed and luminous: mostly near-white (#f5f7f4) and pale celadon mist (#dbe5de), with shadows in muted sage green (#5f8a6c) and only the smallest accents of deep forest green (#013220). The light shimmers: soft halation, faint iridescent and chromatic fringes, vertical light streaks and long-exposure smears, as if light were data passing through glass. Heavy diffusion and fine analog grain, no hard black. Minimal and experimental, with lots of calm empty space; the lower-left third kept quiet and pale so type can sit there. Built, made and human only: no plants, trees, leaves, flowers, water or landscapes. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, signage, screens with writing, logos, watermarks or frames.
style_minimal: Minimal fine-art photograph, almost blank: a vast field of soft white light seen through frosted glass, so overexposed it is fading away. Near-white (#f5f7f4) and the palest celadon mist (#dbe5de); the only shadows are faint muted sage (#5f8a6c), never dark. The light shimmers very gently: delicate halation, the faintest iridescent fringe, a slight vertical smear, fine analog grain. Architectural and quiet, one element at most, everything else empty light; a figure, if any, is tiny or barely there, a trace rather than a person. No plants, nature, water or landscapes. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, signage, logos, watermarks or frames.
